english:
Weapon damage increases Scoot Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters for 3 seconds.

Resist x4 provides <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance while scooting.

source.text:
4 Piece | Shoot to Scoot

Upon dealing Weapon Damage:
Increases Scoot Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters for 3 seconds.

While scooting:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4)
